We are an award winning consultancy that implements technology to improve the delivery of complex construction projects. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. ( Watch our short film about it ) We also have a separate product team, Shape Construction, that takes the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products. The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit kind and authentic people who are fast learners. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of place that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 170 today and we are still very much at the beginning! Our four core values are grow yourself, care about people, execute to greatness and build civilisation. This philosophy goes much deeper and you can see more on our website. W e are achieving this vision through the following two missions: To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society ___________________________________________________________ The Role Purpose of the role As Commercial and Operations Senior Manager, you'll play a pivotal role in protecting and growing Laminar's commercial position, as well as strengthening and continually improving our operational procedures. You'll own the frameworks that govern how we contract with clients and suppliers, manage commercial risk, and run the operations and commercial functions day to day. You'll be the person who makes sure our growth rests on sound contracts, clear policies and efficient operations. That gives our consultants the freedom to focus on delivering great work for clients. Team This is partly a new function, and you'll be building the commercial side of it from the ground up. You'll set its direction, shape its ways of working and grow the team over time. You'll work closely with leadership, group operations, delivery, bids, finance and people teams to make sure the Laminar operations and commercial function gives high-quality support across Laminar. Your top three objectives Get our contracts up to standard. Review and standardise Laminar's client and supplier contract templates, terms and approval processes, so that commercial risk is understood, controlled and consistently managed. Build a robust operating model. Document, streamline and embed the core operational procedures (such as contract lifecycle, onboarding of clients and associates, and commercial reporting) so the business runs predictably as we scale. Establish the operations and commercial function as a trusted partner. Set up the governance, tools and reporting that give leadership clear visibility of performance, risk and opportunity. This should support better decisions on pricing, bids and growth. Your Top Five Responsibilities Build a strong Laminar operations and commercial function: Design and lead Laminar's operational and commercial functions, covering its structure, processes, tools and ways of working, so it can support a growing, globally distributed business. Commercial and operational management: Own the end-to-end contract lifecycle: drafting, negotiation, review, approval, change control and renewal. Oversee commercial risk, pricing inputs, supplier and associate agreements, and operational performance. Develop and enforce policies: Create, maintain and embed clear commercial and operational policies and procedures, such as delegated authority, contract approvals, risk management and compliance. Make sure they are understood and followed across the business. Collaborate across teams: Work with leadership, delivery, bids, finance and people teams to give practical commercial advice. That includes supporting bids and proposals, resolving contractual issues, and making sure commercial decisions support client outcomes. Functional leadership and promoting culture: Lead by example as a senior member of the team. Build a culture of commercial awareness, accountability and continuous improvement, and coach others so good commercial practice becomes part of how Laminar works. You're confident drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial contracts and managing contractual risk. Communication: A precise, structured communicator in English, both written and verbal. You can explain complex issues clearly to non-specialists and senior stakeholders. Leadership: You can manage multiple projects and priorities at once, make sound judgement calls, and work well with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Impact: A track record of improving how organisations work, going well beyond the basics. Nice to Have (If you don’t have it now, you will after joining) Mastery: Experience with commercial contract reviews and commercial management. A relevant qualification (e.g legal or commercial degree]) is a plus. Global perspective: Experience supporting a distributed or multi-jurisdiction business, including contracting across different regions. Leadership : A proven leader, coach or developer of teams, ideally with experience building a new function from scratch. Impact : A track record of putting in place scalable, repeatable commercial and operational solutions, such as contract management systems, approval workflows or reporting frameworks, that made a significant positive difference to a business. Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true: You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge You like to be the smartest person in the room You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team ___________________________________________________________ Benefits The Standard Stuff Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority Pension Scheme. A competitive plan to help you plan for the long term - plus salary sacrifice options available to maximize your savings Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft Cycle to Work Scheme. A tax-efficient way to get wheels - and do your bit for the environment The Life-Changing Stuff Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected. Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Laminar exists. Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Laminar. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us ___________________________________________________________ Important! Applying properly We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining: Why do you want to join us? If you joined, where do you think you could make the most impact and how? We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all applications will be read thoroughly by our key leaders. In terms of application, we usually start with an intro call to tell you what we are all about in a casual conversation. That helps you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
